## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The environment-variable default should be fixed because CI-configured exclusions are ignored, contrary to the CLI policy.

## Changes
The pull request adds repeatable filename exclusions, skip logging, flag documentation, and parser and archive tests. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclude default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude`, `.log` files are still archived because the default is always `[]`. This violates “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable” (.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11). — CI jobs configuring exclusions through the required environment variable include files their configuration explicitly excludes.
